description: RV120 (RV-R2, B3 readers) inputs pinned in the Python reader's B3 tests (I100 B3 repair 01): its G5b order probe with its controls (F1), and its four E/G-hat forgeries (F2). Each is stated as edits from a base the tests already hold, in the shared corpus grammar (07n), and is resealed by the 07e format rule with DEF-E's H. The preserved RV120 mutations are materialized on the current bases and resealed with the current DEF-E. input_sha256 is the sha256 of Python compact, key-sorted JSON of [source, invocation]; the full constructed values also match the current native R1 inputs under JCS. The historical INPUTS_INDEX is provenance, not the current byte identity. Repair 02 (I101) adds RV120's N2 probe, an exact_cases entry for a case not in the invocation, on both bases. Repair 03 (I101) adds the N2b two-fault probe on the exact two_case_synthetic (one entry's profile_mode, the other's material_basis) and its swap, materialized by the Rust reader's B3b shape list. B7b re-states every shape on the current exact route (model 0.5.0, 3.0.0/exact_pressure_v3 with euler_bernoulli and an authored zero corrosion allowance; exact_cases profile_mode exact_pressure_v3; the pressure-1 base's current limitations) and on the current m3x successors; each shape's mutation and documented outcome are unchanged.
record: R/REVIEW_RV120/b3_readers_01/evidence/readers: g5b_order_inputs.jsonl.gz, forge_eg_inputs.jsonl.gz, INPUTS_INDEX.jsonl; N2: b3_probes (its INPUTS_INDEX sha256); N2b: the Rust reader's B3B_INPUTS_OUT (repair 03)

bases.corpus: fixtures/results/retained_precision_cases.json, the case with this id (RS's exact construction starts from it)

shapes.name: X G5b control: case 0's evidence As_m2 one ulp [two_case_synthetic]

value: 3.0.0/exact_pressure_v3 under pressure-1 semantics. Admitted families: small-displacement homogeneous-isotropic straight circular pipe members (Euler-Bernoulli; source OD/effective wall define the single section basis; G is derived from E/nu) and linear restraints or springs; realized curved bends and expansion joints authored as objective connectors are admitted only as the bend and connector limitations state. Every other component, support, combination or equivalent-static family is refused by name (EXACT_PRESSURE_FAMILY_NOT_ADMITTED) until a later contract revision admits it.

Pressure is a signed internal differential with zero external pressure increment, uniform within each explicit case-scoped collinear equal-bore region with explicit closure-transfer paths. A negative differential is admitted, but external-pressure stability and collapse are not assessed.
Not modelled: steady-flow momentum and transient pressure loads; bend opening under pressure (Bourdon effect); pressure stiffening of flexibility factors and stress intensification; ovalization.
Mechanical, pressure-eigen and cap-transfer contributions remain distinct; rounded cap/eigen ledgers are observational and do not replace source-grouped pressure assembly.
Structural line loads act as entered; contents density does not imply hydrostatic pressure head or a coupled static-fluid pressure/weight state.
Signed support actions are attributed only for admitted linear restraints and springs; ambiguous coincident rigid attribution is refused.
The circular normal-stress maximum bounds the supplied binary64 polynomial coefficient enclosures; solution error is separate, and incomplete coverage withholds the headline.

Every member section declares its corrosion allowance and the contract declares its shear model; only a zero allowance and the euler_bernoulli shear model are admitted. This envelope publishes ordinary structural recovery. Retained-source recovery is available only for straight members, linear restraints or springs, nodal force and moment loads and explicitly empty pressure regions; an authored load/reference-state group includes resolved eigenloads and prescribed motions. Other source families are declined by name. No code compliance or professional acceptance is produced, and actual numerical admission remains separate.

Member actions, section actions, stresses and support reactions of a load case reported NUMERICAL_INTEGRITY_CHECKS_PASSED are recovered at 128-bit precision from the formation check's corrected displacement and rounded once; they are not binary64 recomputations from the published displacements, from which they may differ by about 1e-12 of the body's action scale (at most about 6e-9 in the evaluation sets).

The recovery is checked against the formation check's re-formed system (stiffness and loads formed at 128-bit precision from the binary64 inputs). The published displacements are the solve's own, judged by the formation check's per-row rule; support reactions balance the re-formed loads, not the solve's binary64 load vector.
